_comment: Single-crystal CUBIC stiffness constants [GPa]. THIS IS THE ONLY PLACE TO EDIT THEM. Assignment: region (zone tag in micro_<tag>.npz) -> material -> constants indexed by the grain's own crystal system (fcc/bcc, from the EBSD phase id). Each GRAIN then gets its own tensor because its Bunge orientation rotates these constants individually. Values below are LITERATURE PLACEHOLDERS (identical to 069/config.json) - every result scales with them.

trans._comment: Transition zone (Uebergangsbereich): composition unknown. Default = parent-phase constants; edit here to give the transition its OWN crystal constants. The spatially varying scalar prefactor s(x) (--sfun) is the separate knob.
